description: Resolve or search politicians by name, optionally limited by parliamentary period.

current_only.description: Limit to politicians active in the current period.

query.description: Name or partial name of a politician.

sort_by.description: Optional explicit sort field. Omit to keep relevance-first ordering for name searches.

sort_direction.description: Sort direction for explicit sort_by. Defaults to asc.

name: search_persons
